isolation: Index only. Do not store a merged Congo lexicon here. Kituba is a separate dataset under this folder. Kikongo of Angola stays in data/angola_dataset/kikongo/. They are not the same language.
principle: Zero hallucination. Missing data is preferable to incorrect data.

missing_term.message: Query a named language folder under data/rdcongo_dataset/. A merged Democratic Republic of the Congo lexicon is not stored at this path.

license.source_extracts: Cited academic sources retain their original terms. See each language sources.md.

extraction_notes: Parent index of Democratic Republic of the Congo languages. Lexicon is stored only in the language folders, and only from sources that name that language.
